alerts.title: Saudi Pipeline Outage Threatens Loss Of 4% Of Global Oil Supply
alerts.why: Major supply disruption threatening 4% of global oil drives extreme safe-haven buying in gold and massive bullish crude shock.

alerts.title: Brent Hits $108 as Saudi Pipeline Shutdown Deepens Supply Fears
alerts.why: Major supply shock from drone attack on Saudi East-West pipeline cuts 4% of global supply, driving severe geopolitical risk premium.

alerts.title: Middle East shipping squeezed as Hormuz and Bab el-Mandeb risks converge
alerts.why: Simultaneous attacks in Hormuz and Bab el-Mandeb plus Saudi pipeline shutdown threaten critical Middle East supply routes, driving safe-haven and risk premium.

alerts.title: Iran says it destroys U.S. advanced drone over Hormuz as Middle East conflict intensifies
alerts.why: Escalating conflict near the Strait of Hormuz threatens vital crude supply routes, driving safe-haven gold and risk-premium oil prices higher.

alerts.title: Trump urges Ukraine to stop ‘knocking out’ Russian oil refineries as U.S. diesel hits record
alerts.why: Trump urging Ukraine to halt Russian refinery attacks could restore supply, but ongoing US diesel record highs keep broader energy bullish.

alerts.title: Satellite images show extent of damage to Saudi Arabia’s oil pipeline that bypasses Strait of Hormuz
alerts.why: Attacks on Saudi Arabia's East-West pipeline threaten a critical Strait of Hormuz bypass, raising severe supply disruption fears.

alerts.title: Middle East Oil Routes Under Pressure as Hormuz Traffic Tumbles
alerts.why: Severe supply disruption in the Strait of Hormuz and Saudi pipeline shutdown threaten global crude flows, triggering a major geopolitical risk premium.

alerts.title: Brent crude jumps above $108 after Saudi Arabia shuts down critical pipeline that bypasses Strait of Hormuz
alerts.why: Critical Saudi pipeline closure bypassing Hormuz threatens massive oil supply disruption, driving aggressive safe-haven and crude buying.

itemsSent.title: W*T*H: The Seizure of Bab el-Mandeb: Why Tanker Rates Are Exploding
itemsSent.why: Seizure of strategic Bab el-Mandeb chokepoint threatens critical energy supply routes and Saudi exports, spiking freight rates and geopolitical risk premiums.

itemsSent.title: W*T*H: The Seizure of Bab el-Mandeb: Why Tanker Rates Are Exploding
itemsSent.why: Seizure of Bab el-Mandeb chokepoint forces tanker rerouting around Africa, drastically driving up freight costs and tightening crude supply chains.

itemsSent.why: Upcoming inflation reports will dictate Fed rate path, but speculation on Kevin Warsh's future stance offers no immediate market-moving catalyst.

itemsSent.title: Most inflation forecasters see the core CPI rounding down to 0.2% in July.
itemsSent.why: Softer core CPI raises rate cut expectations, weakening the dollar and boosting gold, with minimal immediate impact on crude.

itemsSent.title: Ukrainian drone evades Russian helicopter fire to strike oil tanker
itemsSent.why: Drone strike on a Russian oil tanker raises geopolitical risk to maritime shipping and supply, providing modest support for crude.

itemsSent.title: Russia Hits Odesa Again As Black Sea Shipping Disrupted
itemsSent.why: Black Sea shipping disruptions pose persistent geopolitical risks to trade and Ukrainian grain, offering mild safe-haven support to gold while crude remains largely unaffected.

itemsSent.title: Wright warns oil markets against expecting Iran-Hormuz breakthrough
itemsSent.why: Warning on Strait of Hormuz risks maintains geopolitical risk premium, while substantial alternative routes limit immediate runaway price spikes.

itemsSent.title: Energy price forecasts revised higher amid stalemate
itemsSent.why: Strait of Hormuz tensions and failed US-Iran talks have pushed Brent back to $90, though physical flows remain intact for now.

itemsSent.title: Tehran and Muscat delay talks, citing regional consensus need
itemsSent.why: Delayed talks and Strait of Hormuz tensions heighten geopolitical risk premium for crude, while gold remains largely unaffected.

itemsSent.title: Iran war live: Oman says Hormuz talks with Iran, Gulf states postponed
itemsSent.why: Postponing diplomatic talks on the Strait of Hormuz creates mild uncertainty but lacks immediate supply disruption catalysts to move markets significantly.

itemsSent.title: Yemen’s Houthis advance on government strongholds of Marib, Taiz
itemsSent.why: Houthi advances near Marib elevate regional instability risks in the Middle East, offering mild support to crude oil.
